run_multinode_dino_training: run multinode DINO self-supervised training on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_dino_job_with_executor: submit a DINO training job to a SLURM partition using submitit AutoExecutor with GPU and memory parameters
parse_submitit_training_args: parse command-line arguments for DINO training including ngpus, nodes, timeout, partition, and scheduler comment
setup_trainer_checkpoint_requeue: setup a Trainer class that requeues itself via checkpoint using submitit DelayedSubmission for fault tolerance
generate_init_file_for_dist: generate a unique initialization file URI for distributed training process group synchronization
